ValidationRule.description: Taman Safari deals with a payment plan must be fully paid before Closed Won. Opportunities without Payment Terms (e.g. voucher redemption) are not affected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Taman_Safari", ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), Payment_Terms__c > 0, Total_Paid__c < BLANKVALUE(Amount, 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity must be fully paid before Closed Won. Mark all Payments as Paid so Total Paid equals Amount.
